summary: ```markdown # Two-Way Zippers | Clo Feature Deep Dive ## Introduction Hey all you Clovers! So I'm Phoebe, and I'm going to walk you through this great feature we have now for our zippers. You now can do two-way zippers. That's right, two! So let's jump on in and see how you can accomplish this. ## Overview of Two-Way Zippers Two-way zippers are a fantastic addition to your bags. Here I've got my bag, which is pretty great, and right now I just have one lonely zipper on it. As many of us know, most bags, especially like this one, have two zippers. Now, I'm able to implement that in Clo. ## Selecting Zipper Components To get started, it's really easy. You can just select the zipper slider and puller, but not the tape or teeth. If I select the tape or teeth, the option will not appear in my property editor over here. So, I'm going to select the slider and puller right here. ### Configuring the Zipper Type In the property editor, you see "type." What I'm going to do is select "two-way." It's really as simple as that! After selecting "two-way," I will have the option of "bottom to bottom" or "head to head." The "head to head" option is perfect for bags, as both zippers will be on top. ## Functionality and Simulation What's really nice is that I can still simulate these zippers. They are completely functional, and I can edit each one. I can change these components around, right? They will, of course, stay the same because I don't think many of us would want to use different zipper sliders and pullers. You can also change the gauge and other specifications. ### Unzipping the Zipper Additionally, you can do the thing that we all love: unzip! If I select the tape or teeth, I can unzip if I want to. It will unzip for you, right? So I can pull this apart, and it'll be all unzipped, allowing me to find my keys, my wallet, and a spare pencil that always marks my finger, you know? It's the normal things in life. ## Use Cases It's really great and easy to use. This feature also works on all garments, as you know. You can just keep zipping and unzipping, right? For example, I could unzip this all the way over here too, like a lot of people have. There are not many limitations here. ## Switching Between Zipper Types It's very simple to toggle between types. If I want to go back to a one-way zipper, I can easily switch back to "one-way." Now, I just have my one-way zipper. ## Conclusion Thank you all so much for watching! I hope you're as excited as I am about the two-way zipper feature. Have a great day, and I will see you next time. Bye! ```
